paragraphs.text: Chapter 5 Some terrible news
A short time later, she heard some news.
The prince planned to marry a king's daughter.
I must go to meet the king's daughter.
He said to the mermaid.
She felt very sad about this.
My parents want me to go.
I do not want to marry her.
He said, this made her very happy.
Will you come with me?
I want you to sail on the ship with me.
He asked.
At night, she sat on the deck of the ship.
She looked out into the ocean.
Suddenly, her sisters appeared.
They swam close to the ship.
But they saw a boy on the deck.
The sisters swam deep under the water.
The little mermaid was so disappointed.
Yet, she was happy.
She could see her prince every day.
The boat reached a beautiful town.
The king's daughter lived in this town.
Many people came to the ship and welcomed the prince.
There was a festival all day in the town.
All day, the king's daughter did not appear.
But that night she came.
The prince saw her face.
He knew her face.
You, he cried out.
It was you.
You saved my life.
The prince looked at the little mermaid.
He said, oh, I am so happy now.
Everything is perfect.
I love this woman so much.
And you are beside me.
My life is complete.
The mermaid smiled at him.
But her heart broke in two.
His wedding meant one thing.
She must die.
For the prince and the king's daughter's wedding,
the little mermaid wore a golden dress.
She walked behind the bride in the church.
There was joyful music everywhere.
But she didn't hear the music.
She heard only one thing inside her head.
Today, you will die.
In the evening, they got onto the ship.
They were sailing back to the prince's home.
It was filled with food and music.
On the deck, there were many colored lights.
The mermaid thought, like the first time I saw the prince.
That night, she danced for the prince and his bride.
She danced very elegantly.
But her feet and her heart were in pain.
The prince did not know about her pain.
After that night, she would not see the prince again.
Everything on the ship became very quiet.
The mermaid walked quietly along the deck.
She looked out into the water.
This is my last night, she thought.
In the morning, I will die.
Then, she saw something in the water.
It was her sisters.
They looked different.
Their beautiful hair was gone.
We all cut our hair.
They said to her, we sold it to the witch.
We brought you something to help you.
It is a night.
Kill the prince.
Then, you will not die.
You can become a mermaid again.
You can live with us again.
She took the night from them.
It was very, very sharp.
She walked toward the prince's room.
She went to the prince and his bride.
They were sleeping peacefully.
They were asleep in each other's arms.
The little mermaid leaned down and kissed his cheek.
She looked at the knife.
Then, she looked at the prince.
No, she couldn't kill the prince.
She loved him.
So, she threw the knife through the window.
It dropped into the sea.
She watched it fall.
She looked into the sky.
The sun was rising.
She quickly ran to the deck.
She threw herself into the sea.
She felt the cold water.
I am dying.
She thought.
Suddenly, the little mermaid felt herself above the water.
She felt her body.
She was in the air.
She saw other beautiful beings.
Where am I?
Who are you?
What is happening?
She asked them.
We are the daughters of the air.
They told her.
We give life to people.
We carry the sweet smell of flowers and perfume.
You are now a daughter of the air.
You were a mermaid.
They continued.
You tried so hard to earn a soul.
The daughters of the air can live for 300 years.
But by doing good, we can earn a soul.
I can earn a soul.
This is wonderful.
She looked into the sky and thought.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Now she looked toward the ship.
It was sailing calmly on the ocean.
Then, she saw the prince and his bride.
They were looking for her.
Their faces were white.
They looked into the sea.
They looked so sad.
The little mermaid went to them.
Of course, they could not see her.
She moved her body around them.
They felt the cool air move around them.
She kissed the prince and his bride.
Then, she flew away.
She joined her sisters in the air.
They went for doing good together.
300 years from now.
The little mermaid will get a soul.
